evidence_items.claim_short: Wild chimpanzees produce a large repertoire of non-random vocal-visual combinations across multiple call types
evidence_items.confidence_rationale: 297 vocal events yielded 108 vocal-visual combinations occurring above chance; even low-frequency pant bark and whimper had significant collocations
evidence_items.do_not_overclaim: Above-chance collocation is not compositional semantics, syntax or receiver comprehension
evidence_items.alternative_explanations: Visibility, context and shared arousal may drive some co-occurrence; rare call counts are small

evidence_links.weight_or_confidence_basis: 108 above-chance combinations across seven call types
evidence_links.alternative_explanation_addressed: Co-occurrence does not establish compositional function

evidence_items.claim_short: Free multimodal grunt–gesture combinations in wild Kanyawara chimpanzees increased recipient response probability relative to grunt alone, but not relative to gesture alone
evidence_items.scope_boundary: Kanyawara natural free multimodal grunt–gesture events with matched unimodal components
evidence_items.independent_replication: related convergence from S0015 and S0017; exact matched-component effect not independently replicated
evidence_items.ars_confidence: moderate-high for bounded response effect; low for added semantic content
evidence_items.confidence_rationale: Within-study matched-component comparison shows gain over grunt alone but not gesture alone, constraining both pure-context and strong-composition interpretations
evidence_items.do_not_overclaim: Do not treat multimodal combination as automatically more meaningful/effective than its strongest component; no fixed gloss or compositional semantics established
evidence_items.method_boundary: Naturalistic observational signal production and recipient response; no randomized stimulus manipulation
evidence_items.alternative_explanations: Gesture may carry the principal response-driving information; vocal element may act as attention getter, redundancy, disambiguator, or context-correlated addition
evidence_items.reproducibility_status: publication/accepted manuscript accessible; raw corpus/code unresolved

evidence_items.claim_short: In the S0084 Chimfunshi corpus, manual-gesture and facial-expression configurations are associated with different affiliative versus non-affiliative recipient responses in a context-dependent manner
evidence_items.scope_boundary: Two semi-wild Chimfunshi groups; focal stretched-arm/bent-arm gestures with neutral, bared-teeth or funneled-lip faces
evidence_items.evidence_channels: reception; multimodal combination; context; dyadic interaction
evidence_items.behavioral_validation: recipient response directly coded as affiliative/non-affiliative
evidence_items.independent_replication: same-data reanalysis by S0085; independent biological replication not established
evidence_items.ars_confidence: moderate for within-corpus response association; low for fixed component meaning/compositional semantics
evidence_items.confidence_rationale: 252-event corpus with repeated identities/dyads and contextual controls; public raw data and independent reanalysis increase inspectability, but setting and sampling are bounded
evidence_items.do_not_overclaim: Do not equate response association with stable facial/gesture meanings; do not infer compositionality or non-compositionality from directionally inconsistent effects alone
evidence_items.method_boundary: Naturalistic observational event coding + mixed-effects analyses; no experimental signal manipulation
evidence_items.alternative_explanations: Context, dominance/rank, dyad, individual identity, target-event sampling, sanctuary ecology and other unmeasured social state can influence both signal configuration and response
evidence_items.reproducibility_status: raw dataset public; original local bytes pending; independent analysis code public

evidence_items.claim_short: The S0084 response pattern does not uniquely identify a compositional or non-compositional system; explicit competing theoretical models remain viable on the same observations
evidence_items.scope_boundary: Interpretive/model-comparison boundary for S0084 face-gesture corpus
evidence_items.behavioral_validation: uses the same coded recipient-response observations as S0084
evidence_items.ars_confidence: high for methodological caution; not a biological-function claim
evidence_items.confidence_rationale: Independent authors reanalyzed the public data and demonstrated that alternative compositional interpretations can be constructed, especially when dominance is considered
evidence_items.do_not_overclaim: Do not count this as independent animal evidence for compositionality; it constrains interpretation and requires prospective empirical discriminators
evidence_items.alternative_explanations: Multiple theoretical systems can fit sparse observational response patterns; model flexibility and post hoc explanation risk

evidence_items.claim_short: Under PRER-RQ0001-SEQ-v0.1, the registered coarse event-level sequence features did not improve prediction of the source-coded recipient-outcome class beyond the registered baseline in development or locked Waibira transfer
evidence_items.scope_boundary: D0020 released wild gesture-exchange corpus; registered Y_recipient target; registered B0/B1 feature sets and logistic model; five source communities
evidence_items.evidence_channels: registered secondary analysis; recipient outcome; sequence structure; cross-community transfer; negative/null evidence
evidence_items.behavioral_validation: Source-coded final recipient outcome directly enters the registered prediction target; no semantic interpretation assigned
evidence_items.independent_replication: Waibira was prospectively held out from ARS fitting, but remains within the same published study/framework; no independent-study replication
evidence_items.ars_confidence: high for the bounded registered model/target result; low for any broader absence claim
evidence_items.confidence_rationale: Both preregistered criteria failed with frozen artifacts and a one-time locked population evaluation; negative result is reproducible and protected from post-hoc retuning under v0.1
evidence_items.do_not_overclaim: Do not infer that chimpanzee gestural exchanges lack temporal organization, interactional structure, semantic content or compositionality. The result concerns only incremental prediction from four coarse sequence features for one anonymized outcome target.
evidence_items.population_boundary: Sonso, Issa, Kalinzu and Kanyawara development; Waibira locked transfer; all within D0020/S0018
evidence_items.method_boundary: Preregistered L2 logistic prediction with grouped CV and frozen population holdout; gesture form absent from release
evidence_items.alternative_explanations: Coarse features may discard informative gesture identity/timing detail; anonymized Goal baseline may absorb relevant structure; outcome label may not capture all recipient response; richer context/state and other model families remain plausible
evidence_items.reproducibility_status: RUN-003 and RUN-004 exact reports/results/predictions preserved; frozen model coefficients and preprocessing parameters preserved

evidence_links.evidence_channel: registered null prediction; recipient outcome; sequence structure; cross-community transfer
evidence_links.population_scope: Five wild East African communities; Waibira locked transfer
evidence_links.method_scope: PRER-RQ0001-SEQ-v0.1 B0 versus B1 logistic prediction
evidence_links.independence_level: development grouped CV + held-out population within same source study
evidence_links.replication_relation: prospective cross-community transfer; not independent-study replication
evidence_links.weight_or_confidence_basis: Both preregistered log-loss criteria failed; exact frozen artifacts and one-time Waibira predictions preserved
evidence_links.alternative_explanation_addressed: Shows the registered coarse sequence features add no predictive increment for this target; does not address richer gesture identity/context or broader semantics
evidence_links.notes: RUN-003 and RUN-004 exact reports preserved
